# Caddy — root-to-custom-context-sse

Proxy at /, app on /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The event stream and the client-to-server POSTs both ride the same prefix-adding rewrite, and the Location and Set-Cookie rewrites are unchanged from the WebSocket sibling.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/http/root-to-custom-context-sse/vaadin.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# Proxy at /, app on the /app context, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# templates/add-prefix.caddyfile plus the refusal from
# templates/passthrough-sse.caddyfile. The event stream and the client-to-server
# POSTs both ride the same prefix-adding rewrite, and the Location and
# Set-Cookie rewrites are unchanged from the WebSocket sibling.
:80 {
	import common

	@upgrade header Upgrade *
	respond @upgrade 501

	rewrite * /app{uri}

	reverse_proxy vaadin:8080 {
		header_down Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/app(/.*)$ $1$2
		header_down Set-Cookie ^(.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/app(;.*)?$ $1/$2
	}
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
